page.overview:
Who is Al Sneed?

Al Sneed, known informally as Sneed, is the owner of Sneed's Feed & Seed, a convenience store close to the Farm where Homer grew up. Sneed purchased the store from Chuck and his wives for an undisclosed amount, later renaming it to place a greater emphasis on agricultural supplies. Sneed and Chuck remain on good terms with Chuck occasionally working at the convenience store alongside an elderly man.
